Thus the comparison shows lower disparity with lower accuracy, rather than universal superiority.

In the completed eleven-method native table, the balanced ten-seed means are ACC 88.42%, AEOD 0.0097 and ASPD 0.0610 for GuardFed-AD2+, versus 89.35%, 0.0439 and 0.1119 for FLGMM. Each seed is averaged over all ten distribution–scenario cells before summarizing across seeds. GuardFed has lower mean AEOD and ASPD but lower mean accuracy than FLGMM in each of those ten cells. These descriptive directions do not establish significance or uniform superiority: FLTrust retains higher balanced mean accuracy than GuardFed, and LoGoFair retains lower balanced mean ASPD.
